task.description: WF-03, step 5 — SECURITY-REVIEWER, gate, pass 1 of at most 3, on the fix of ISS-0092 (REQ-110, the tools/ Node floor) as built at steps 04 (BACKEND-DEV, tools/src/node-floor.js) and 04b (CODE-FIXER, S2-S6): the change is the diff of the working tree against the tag base/ISS-0092-20261117-01 in the write sets of those two handoffs (tools/src/node-floor.js; the eleven entry points of design section 3; tools/src/pixel-office/hook.sh; tools/package.json line 8 and tools/package-lock.json line 17; .github/workflows/check.yml; tools/README.md lines 9, 36, 157, 207; .githooks/pre-push line 32) — the other changed files of the tree belong to the runs M0DOCS-20261117-01 and SECREG-20261118-01 and are not part of this review. Read the code yourself against docs/design/REQ-110-tools-node-floor.md (gate PASS at step 03d), the block REQ-110 (amended) and decisions/0101, 0119, 0120 (О1-О17), by "Step 5" of docs/workflows/WF-03-defect.md and "Step 3" of docs/workflows/WF-02-development.md. You decide whether your area is touched. The main question: is the cause removed, or does the fix only hide the symptom; and try to break it yourself: (a) the guard is the first statement of the work in the same function as the action in every entry point — nothing is read, written, started or sent before it (state folders, home, TMPDIR, the network, a browser, a child process), and the command dispatch comes after it; (b) the refusal line holds no value but versions (a hostile version text, a control character, a very long text, a non-string) and is one line; (c) the hook: candidates from node-path, PATH and the fallbacks — a candidate that prints a hostile or huge --version text, a symlink, a non-executable, a candidate in a folder writable by others; stdin from /dev/null; exit 0 quiet; no shell injection through the version text or a path with spaces or quotes; the named limit of a hanging candidate (decisions/0120 О4) stated in the README; (d) check.yml: check-latest: true downloads the newest 22.x on the runner — say whether it changes the supply chain beyond the pinned setup-node action and whether the version is still bounded by engines; (e) the picker and the e2e runner refuse before any server or browser starts; (f) no secret, no machine path, no external call added; nothing swallowed except the documented throwing write. Repeat on a fresh clone of the tag outside the project with the changed files copied in, with simulated Node versions only (a preload with a positive control): the refusal under 22.21.1 and 22.23.3 for every row of design 9.2 with a hash list of the folders before and after; your own attacks of (a)-(f); at least 8 mutants of your own of the security-relevant places (the guard moved after a write, the hook reading the version through a shell, the version shown raw, and so on), each with what catches it or the gap. CI-3 and CI-8 of tools/test/repo.test.js are red by the design until step 6 (EXPECTED_RED, named in step 04b's result.issues); they are not a finding of this step. Any item not passed is a FAIL; findings ranked (Critical, High, Medium block). SAFETY: simulate Node versions only — never install or download an old Node; never start Pixel Office or its hook with the real home or the real Pixel Office state folder (a private HOME and a state folder under your own temporary root); servers only on 127.0.0.1 port 0, never 4780, 4781, 4782 or 4790; a team server only through the starter with a temporary SAI_TEAM_HOME and the trap copy as SAI_TEAM_CLAUDE_BIN; never set SAI_TEAM_REAL_RUNS; never start the real claude; never import a program file to read it; TMPDIR of every run inside your own folder; npm_config_update_notifier=false and only local binaries; a command denied by the permission check is not done another way. Do not run the full npm run check of the project. Change no project file other than this handoff; no commit, push or pull. The handoff holds no absolute machine paths, no temporary paths and no names of other projects of the owner.
acceptance_criteria: the guard first in every entry point: nothing read, written, started or sent before it; the dispatch after it
the refusal line and the hook safe against hostile version texts and paths; no injection, no secret, no machine path, no external call added
own attacks and at least 8 own mutants on a fresh clone with simulated versions; PASS only if every item holds

findings.item: Q10 (the hook stays quick and quiet: REQ-110 criterion 4, REQ-001 criterion 15)
findings.place: tools/src/pixel-office/hook.sh lines 54-61 (node_ok: the --version text in v is unbounded; split3 runs `case "$1" in "" | *[!0-9.]*)` and `${rest%%.*}` over all of it)
findings.what: Under macOS /bin/sh (bash 3.2) the time of the shape check grows faster than the length of a candidate's --version text. Digits only: 10 000 characters 262 ms, 100 000 367 ms, 300 000 948 ms, 1 000 000 7 910 ms, 2 000 000 over 30 000 ms (killed by my limit); 20 MB of junk 6 445 ms in a UTF-8 locale (604 ms in C). The tag's hook takes 168 ms and 171 ms for 1 and 2 million digits (its case v22.* reads a prefix); /bin/dash takes 446 ms at 5 million. Such a candidate holds the hook past the 4 s handler time-out of .claude/settings.json, which ends it: the event is lost and never written later, the session is not disturbed — the effect of the named limit 2 by another cause (an answer too long, not no answer), and README line 207 names only «does not answer». A real Node prints about 9 characters, and a candidate is a binary of the person's own environment, so whoever can make one print megabytes already runs code as the person: no security border is crossed.
findings.fix: One line right after line 54: `[ "${#v}" -le 30 ] || return 1` (the longest accepted text is 23 characters). Measured on a copy: 5 million digits 319 ms, 20 MB of junk in UTF-8 735 ms, all 68 rows of my hook attacks green under /bin/sh and /bin/dash, the accepted twins v22.999999999.0 and v22.23.999999999 still taken. Or, if the design keeps the script, name «an answer of more than about 0.3 MB» beside limit 2 in design section 17 and README line 207 (pinned whole by NF-09, AP-077). Either is a design choice for ORCH; not blocking.

findings.item: Q7 border / design section 3 («before any read of the environment»)
findings.place: tools/src/pixel-office/note.js line 342 (`home: os.homedir()` in the entry block; the guard is at line 275 inside main)
findings.what: Under a refused Node, pixel-office-note asks Node for the home folder path before main and its guard run: it reads the HOME value (or the user list when HOME is unset), no file of the home; nothing else is read and the value is not used before the refusal. The same call stands on the tag (line 339) and under --help; the ten other entry points pass only references (process.env, the streams). So «nothing is read before the guard» holds for files, folders, children and the network, not for this one value lookup.
findings.fix: No change needed for security. If the design's words are to hold literally: resolve the home inside main after the guard (pass io.home lazily), or record the exception in the design's «As built» at step 10 or in the follow-up LOW defect of decisions/0119 О6. Not blocking.

issues.text: The permission check of the session denied one command of mine: an automated search of the added lines of the 18 files for secret shapes, network words, swallowed errors and machine paths (a zsh array built from my file list, then git diff and grep). The check named it a removal it could not parse; the command held no removal. It was not repeated in any form.
